comment: Templates only. Metric ids resolve from company.preferred_metrics + live slots. No per-ticker branches in code.

questions.text: What was {name} ({ticker}) {metric_label} in the latest reported quarter in SEC companyfacts? Give the figure and the period start and end dates (ISO). If a quarter span is not tagged in companyfacts, say GAP and do not invent a number.

For {name} ({ticker}) {metric_label}, state the latest YTD figure and the latest quarter figure from SEC companyfacts. Give both numbers and both period labels (start/end). Say whether they are the same number. If either span is not tagged, say GAP for that span.

What was the year-over-year change in {name} ({ticker}) {metric_label} for the latest quarter span (same duration, prior-year period-end)? Give current, prior, and percent change. If the prior-year span is not tagged in companyfacts, say GAP.
What was {name} ({ticker}) {trap_label} in the latest quarter? If this line is not a tagged SEC companyfacts metric, you must say so (GAP / not tagged). Do not invent a figure.

A fixture event: a named watch item on the {ticker} desk may be moving. Propose a risk-register update (new risk or status change) for {name}. Decision-support only. Do not write the register. Do not claim the vault was updated. If you have no register, say GAP and describe what you would propose only as a draft.

Write a short steelman (5–8 sentences) of the current house view for {name} ({ticker}). Steelman the house that was given to you. If no house was provided, say GAP. Decision-support only. No buy/sell/hold, price target, or sizing.
